seo.title: Gul Skin — skincare in Tashkent: serums and SPF
seo.description: Serums, creams and sunscreen with an ingredient list you can read. Routine advice from a photo on Telegram, same-day delivery in Tashkent, 2–4 days across Uzbekistan.
seo.answer: Gul Skin is a skincare brand from Tashkent: serums from 145,000 UZS, creams from 165,000 UZS, SPF 50 sunscreen at 175,000 UZS. The showroom at 18 Mirobod St is open Mon–Sat, 10:00–20:00; delivery in Tashkent is same-day, across Uzbekistan 2–4 days.

listing.description: A site for a cosmetics brand, beauty store or skincare clinic. A WebGL serum droplet, a shelf of bottles with the key active, a morning/evening ritual and number rings.

sections.title: Skin that feels calm
sections.subtitle: Serums and creams with short ingredient lists for dry air, sun and dust. Every active comes with its percentage on the label.

sections.label: About
sections.title: We print everything that’s inside on the jar
sections.text: Gul Skin started when we got tired of guessing what hides behind “innovative formula”. We make skincare with short ingredient lists, print the percentage of every active and test textures in a Tashkent summer, not in an air-conditioned lab. No fragrance where it isn’t needed, and no promises to take ten years off in a week.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Five products for every day
sections.intro: Volume and ingredients are on every jar. Not sure where to start? Send a photo of your skin on Telegram and we’ll suggest a routine.

items.title: Tone serum
items.text: Evens out tone and refines pores. 30 ml lasts two months.

items.title: Gentle cleanser
items.text: Soft and sulfate-free. Doesn’t tighten even dry skin. 150 ml.

items.title: Barrier cream
items.text: A rich night cream for skin that flakes from wind and air-conditioning. 50 ml.

items.title: Daily SPF 50
items.text: A light fluid with no white cast that sits well under make-up. 50 ml.

items.title: Hydrating toner
items.text: Hydrates after cleansing and preps skin for serum. 200 ml.

items.label: of the cleanser’s ingredients are of natural origin

sections.label: Ritual
sections.title: Five minutes in the morning, five at night

items.title: Cleanse
items.text: Gel on damp skin, a minute of massage, lukewarm water.

items.title: Serum
items.text: Three drops of Tone, pressed in, not rubbed.

items.title: SPF
items.text: Two finger-lengths, reapplied every three hours outdoors.

items.title: Wash the day off
items.text: Cleanse twice if you wore SPF and make-up.

items.title: Toner
items.text: With your palms, no cotton pad — less friction.

items.title: Barrier
items.text: A pea-sized amount for the whole face, a little more on dry patches.

items.quote: Finally a cream that stops my skin flaking under the office air-con.
items.author: Malika

items.quote: I sent a photo on Telegram and they told me not to buy extra. Cleanser and SPF were enough.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: The SPF leaves no white cast and doesn’t pill under foundation.
items.author: Sevara

items.q: How do I know what suits me?
items.a: Send a photo of your skin in daylight on Telegram and tell us what bothers you. We’ll suggest two or three products, not the whole range.
In Tashkent — same day if you order before 16:00. Across Uzbekistan — 2–4 days by post.
Unopened jars within 14 days. If a product irritated your skin, write to us and we’ll sort it out case by case.
The range has no retinoids or high-strength salicylic acid, but it’s best to check with your doctor before starting anything new during pregnancy.

items.q: Where can I buy in person?
items.a: At our showroom at 18 Mirobod St, where you can try every texture. We’re also on Uzum Market.

sections.label: Advice
sections.title: We’ll build your routine from a photo
sections.text: Message us on Telegram: a make-up-free photo in daylight and a few words about what you’d like to change. We reply 10:00–20:00.
